coverage_note: Section III of the editor's introduction and the sections that name constitution in their own headings - the interweaving of retention and protention, the alternative model of the primal process, the grasping-perception question, the unity of the functioning primal process, and the temporal essential determinations of constituting consciousness. No unit carries a stratum: the commentary dates the two Bernau stays but does not assign the individual texts to either, so nothing here can be placed on the 1917/1918 division.

units.claim: After the transcendental-phenomenological reduction the relation between absolute consciousness and sensation-datum was re-determined as a constitutive relation, sensation constituting itself in absolute consciousness as an immanent time-object.
units.quote: the relation between "absolute" consciousness and sensation-datum was re-determined as a constitutive relation. Just as a transcendent object constitutes itself in the apprehension of a sensation-datum, so sensation itself constitutes itself in "absolute" consciousness as a (present, past, or future) immanent time-object.

units.claim: The C-manuscripts deny all original constitutive achievement to the primal stream running without ego-participation: constitution of temporal objects requires an ego-achievement.
units.quote: The C-manuscripts ultimately lead Husserl to deny all original constitutive achievement to the primal stream running without any ego-participation. Constitution of temporal objects is possible only when an ego-achievement is present.

units.claim: The hyletic primal stream gains constitutive significance only through a subsequent egoic act of reflection that modifies its nature.
units.quote: Only through the subsequent performance of an egoic act of reflection on the pre-intentional primal process, i.e., through an intervening modification of its nature, does the hyletic primal stream gain constitutive significance.

units.claim: The event constitutes itself with an open event-horizon that is itself a protentional horizon, and every primal process, once primal processes have become constitutive, will be constitutively apperceived.
units.quote: Thus the event constitutes itself with an open event-horizon that is itself a protentional horizon. Genetically: even if no concretely determinate expectation precedes the event, every primal process—once primal processes have become constitutive at all—will be constitutively apperceived.

units.claim: The genetic task is to make comprehensible how a constitutive process can form at all before any constitutive process has been accomplished.
units.quote: The genetic task would be to make comprehensible how a constitutive process can form at all before any constitutive process has been accomplished

units.claim: Two possibilities are put: either the primal process constantly constitutes phenomenological time even without grasping, or reflection brings in a time-constituting that was not already at play.
units.quote: The primal process is constantly constituting phenomenological time with its time-filling immanent objects, even without grasping

units.claim: The beginning of the constitution of a time-event-consciousness is the moment an ur-datum appears and stimulates the ego to grasping.
units.quote: When an ur-datum appears and stimulates the ego to grasping, this is the beginning of the constitution of a time-event-consciousness.

units.claim: Without grasping there would be no time-constituting apprehensions and no constituted temporal event: all objecthood, time itself included, is a product of constitutive functions.
units.quote: Without grasping, we would have the mere primal process without any time-constituting apprehensions and thus no really constituted temporal event, no phenomenological time. All objecthood, even time itself, is a product of constitutive functions

units.claim: The constituting event and the constituted event are constituted in one and the same constitution, the constituting sequence being implied in itself.
units.quote: The constituting event and the constituted event are constituted in one and the same constitution. The constituting sequence as sequence is peculiarly implied in the constituting sequence itself.

units.claim: Every concrete experience is a unity of becoming constituting itself as object in inner consciousness in the form of time, and the question is what the time-constitution of experiences does to their intentional objects.
units.quote: Every concrete experience is a unity of becoming, constituting itself as object in inner consciousness in the form of time. What influence does the necessary time-constitution of experiences have on their intentional objects?

units.claim: Directly constituted objects necessarily have a time-form belonging to their being, while for mediately constituted objects immanent time serves as apprehensive representative.
units.quote: The directly constituted objects (both those of inner consciousness and the ego-foreign hyletic objects) necessarily have a time-form belonging to their being. When objects are mediately constituted (e.g., "physical" spatial objects), immanent time serves as apprehensive representative

absences.expected_because: The question how a flowing consciousness of the elapsing presence is possible is the question the neighbouring sections answer with time-constituting apprehension. This section works it through without any term of the family.

Retention is treated here against phantasy and image-consciousness, and retention is what S 4 makes the interweaving partner of protention in the constitution of phenomenological temporal objectivity. No term of the family occurs.
